source_text.GH#2535: Org-scoped role grants stage 2 (decision 0051): grant CRUD, flag on with flip gate, compiler scope arg, 404 equivalence, F1 approver rule, plus all added ACs and the carried-over stage-1 S10 items.

task.description: WF-02 step 1: draft the requirement entry for GH #2535 into docs/requirements.yaml, split into separately mergeable PRs with tagged ACs. No validation, no implementation.

result.summary: Revision 3. GH #2535 stage 2 drafted as THREE requirements (all gh: 2535, appended after REQ-516 in docs/requirements.yaml): REQ-517 = slices 2a (grant CRUD, FK, retire guard, last-row/zero-admin/self-grant guards, service principal act, single-writer mix check) + 2b (route classification, Authorize under on, attachment links pinned, persisted shadow evidence, stored value on) with 23 ACs; REQ-518 = 2c-i (required scope arg on compile/compile_aggregate/run_aggregate, 9 call sites, ScopeDeclaration, predicate, joins) + 2c-ii (404 equivalence, old/new value writes, all-or-nothing bulk/import, revocation, record attachments) + 2d (approver rule F1, tasks.scope_node_id column without writer, docs/roles.md) with 18 ACs, depends_on REQ-517; REQ-519 = 2e (enforced-tenant writer table, grant.sync_suppressed, binding.pending_scope) + 2f (flag on settable, flip gate, audit, e2e) with 20 ACs, depends_on REQ-518 and REQ-517. Total 61 ACs. All three titles <= 100 chars. File parses as YAML, 458 unique ids. No mix run, nothing committed.
risks: 2c breaks every Compiler caller by design (9 call sites found)
scoped approvers see no task until W3b under the recommended OQ-1
every entity type is undeclared today so scoped principals see no entity data in on mode (OQ-2)
AC 11 self-add refusal changes an existing admin route
2c is large; ORCH may split it with a new id from the allocator

OQ-7 shadow-evidence gate: 7 days, 100 requests, zero no_grant_rows/grants_unavailable, persisted counters in 2b
supervisor_2026-10-17_round2: Service-principal exception covers ONLY the mint subset check; tokens of a flagged owner STILL block the on flip: stated in the description and the decision-record amendment paragraph of REQ-517, REQ-518, REQ-519; explicit test in REQ-519 AC 9

Shadow-evidence criterion ACCEPTED (7 days, >=100 requests, zero no_grant_rows/grants_unavailable); persisted per-tenant counters keep their writer in REQ-517 AC 22 (must ship earlier), REQ-519 AC 11 reads them server-side in the flip transaction; cross-referenced both ways

REQ-497 is status pending although GH #2533 is closed; Compiler.run_aggregate/2 is a 9th call site; test/letflow/tasks does not exist (tests are test/letflow/routers/tasks*_test.exs)
